name: Phidias's Hoard
purpose: Remodelling and sculpting studio for game scenery: takes a low-poly game model apart into pieces and rebuilds each one in Blender with modelling operations in clean quads (tiled hipped roofs, storeys with posts and panels, lathed spires, bevelled blocks, stairs), as a .blend and an OBJ. Sculpting studio for 3D printing: opens low-poly game scenery (OBJ with MTL and textures, GLB/glTF, or zips of them) and carves into the mesh the relief its textures and normal maps only draw (cracks, joints between blocks, steps, column flutes, roof tiles), at print size and in millimetres. Refines the mesh only where the relief needs it, closes the ground into a solid block, can fuse everything into one watertight solid with Blender and exports STL. A vision model can direct the sculpt (decides each material, looks at a test and redoes it) and materials can take added detail by real size (rock, cracks, cobble, bricks, planks, tiles, bark, ripples, flutes). Assistants can browse the library, open projects, look at each material and at the result, change recipes and depths, sculpt and export.
notes: remodel_plan lists the piece types with their guessed kind; remodel_set changes kind (roof, tiled, body, block, lathe, sweep, stairs, organic = a faceted figure rounded into small quads with its texture's drawing, keep, drop; only the ones listed as allowed for the type) and params per type (lathe sides = prism, emboss 0 = leave out what the textures draw); remodel_start builds the .blend and the quad OBJ (job_status), with direct=true the vision model chooses the kinds, looks and corrects; model_look result=remodel shows it with its edges; result_export result=remodel copies both files. library_scan lists game models in the user's folders; project_create opens one and guesses a recipe per material; material_look returns a picture (texture | normal map | height map: white raised, black carved); material_set changes recipe (normal, relief, lines, flat, drop, auto), depth_mm, invert, smooth ('*' = every material); project_set changes size_mm (longest side), min_edge_mm (finest detail), max_faces, ground, base_mm, plinth; material_set enrich {pattern, size_mm, depth_mm} adds sculpted detail the texture does not hold (no_enrich removes it), cutout cuts by transparency, steps turns drawn stairs into steps; direct_start (optional wish in words, rounds) lets the family's vision model decide every material, sculpt a test, look at it and redo it before the final sculpt, and leaves its reasons in project.director; sculpt_start, direct_start and close_start run in the background (job_status); model_look returns a picture of before, sculpt or closed from any yaw/pitch, zoomed on region [x, y, z, radius] in print millimetres, or with compare=true next to the original; result_export writes the STL (millimetres, base at z = 0) next to the source model in a Phidias folder or in the given folder. Z is up.
